lens: Motion choreography and causal storytelling: whether ordered reveals explain a dependency, whether identity and the selected state survive all five phases, and whether a stopped process actually stays stopped.
evidence: Independently inspected the manifest, topic briefs, jury and production contracts, all 20 rationale files, and the SVG/render-state/CSS source for all five phases and every supplied interaction choice. Visually inspected all 20 host-produced Chrome entry screenshots and the four topic contact sheets. These are static phase-2 default-choice images; the other phases and alternate choices were evaluated from source, not personally observed in a browser. All animation judgments are inferred from authored CSS, timing, geometry and class assignments; I did not watch animation. Read motion-lab/verification.json: 20 submissions, zero missing, 225 phase/choice renders, with per-entry size and translation metrics. Those checks do not establish semantic correctness, collision freedom or mobile usability. Small-label concerns are inferred from the contact sheets and SVG font sizes, not a physical-device test. No other juror ballot was read.

scores.reason: Context ink and structure port projections establish a clear drawing vocabulary; explore adds a real valve bypass and outcome preserves the selected state. However, the alternate review branch starts at x=153 while the pump is centered at x=162, intersecting the pump instead of preserving the downstream tie-in from explore. Draw/reveal timing is useful but mostly shared across scenes. The warm sheet reads clearly; repeated headlines and small technical labels consume space.

Context has the most immediately physical plant silhouette, structure exposes ports, and explore makes the additional route tangible. Review and outcome always include the bypass even when Base route is selected, breaking causal continuity. Source uses recurring rise/fade and flow dashes more than a coordinated equipment-to-port transformation. Detailed flanges aid recognition at large size but lose value when reduced; a physical pipe model also needs clear separation from formal P&ID semantics.

Context separation, structure registration, explore local redline, review's three staggered trace disclosures, and the outcome's open review packet form the most coherent authored five-phase arc. Bypass geometry and selected state remain consistent. CSS gives registration and evidence sequencing distinct jobs rather than only decorative motion. Several labels shrink with scaled sheets, and the large internal heading repeats host content. The incomplete review seal is stronger than a checkmark or approval stamp.

Context equipment, structure magnification and explore topology explain the connection story with readable symbols; review retains the selected route and an approval gate. Outcome shifts to a circular source/ports/change motif, weakening the physical continuity established earlier. CSS scales the magnifier and repeats conducting dashes; it does not actually morph the equipment port into the enlarged port. Labels and route geometry prevent color from carrying the entire distinction, but circulating dots add little in the final scene.

Context sheet depth, structure separation, explore's paired drawing/calculation films, review overlay and outcome registration give the five phases different spatial roles. The bypass choice also creates an unresolved calculation trace. However, the review sheet labeled Original calls drawing(alt,true), so the proposed bypass appears on the supposed original. Oblique miniatures and the combined outcome overlays risk crowding, and the outward left route arrow is ambiguous as a flow cue. The registration motion remains a valuable causal device.

pid.synthesis: Create a new anchored route study: one restrained physical pump silhouette resolves into a large orthographic source line, while a narrow identity strip registers directly beneath its ports. The choice draws a bypass only between fixed downstream-of-pump tie-ins. A local magnified tie-in then lifts a calculation-question strip and a separate review contour; the unmodified source remains visible underneath. Finish with two clearly separated source/proposal records joined by those same identities, with approval open. Rework P2's physical recognition, P1's ink hierarchy, P4's port close-up, P3's local registration/redline and P5's separate responsibilities into new geometry; do not adopt any whole submission. Reduce sheet microtext and let geometry carry the phase changes.

contributions.P1: Use construction-ink versus redline contrast and downward port projection. Rebuild review geometry from the same route model so its tie-in cannot move into the pump.
contributions.P2: Use a simplified dimensional pump/valve silhouette to establish the equipment early. Reject the full persistent isometric plant and the unconditional bypass in later phases.
contributions.P3: Use delayed local redline disclosure, registration crosses and the visibly incomplete review seal. Recompose the final source/proposal relationship instead of copying its full paper packet.
contributions.P4: Use a port close-up anchored to a fixed identified endpoint. Reject circular conducting motion in the outcome because it adds activity without explaining a new dependency.
contributions.P5: Use physically separate drawing, identity, calculation and review responsibilities that align only after inspection. Keep the original route immutable and simplify overlapping films for small displays.

scores.reason: Context input discipline, structure loop, explore's shared calculated dial/curve state, review's unselected pipe bores and outcome's pending selection form a sound sequence. Higher resistance correctly reduces Q on an unchanged pump curve. The authored needle only fades/rises at its final angle while the arc draws; the rotor rotation is unrelated to a calculated transient. That is less causal choreography than the kinetic-instrument premise suggests. The large readout helps, but graph labels and the small dial endpoints compete.

Context vessels, structure apparatus separation, explore throttle/head/flow changes, review's matching intersection plot and outcome's open candidate checklist create an unusually tangible progression. The interaction changes several mutually consistent cues and carries the selected point into review. Filling and rotor animations are illustrative entrances rather than measured transients, which the rationale acknowledges. Large vessel silhouettes survive reduction well; the small numerical and evidence labels still need mobile review. Outcome appropriately avoids selecting either pipe candidate.

Context and structure explain head expenditure; explore connects ribbon width and elevation to the analytical operating point; review exposes roughness/OEM gaps and outcome keeps the solved Q. The continuous ribbon is a useful causal object, although the moving flecks have no calculated speed meaning. The 64/36 loss split is explicitly illustrative, and review switches to a generic fixed ribbon rather than preserving quantitative geometry. Compact plot and 16px labels are weak at small width; the loss metaphor is otherwise distinctive.

Context atlas, structure ruled head differences, explore's exact crossing, review lens and outcome comparison are mathematically coherent. The unchanged pump, ghost baseline and leftward lower-flow witness are strong. Many contour offsets and their reveal motion are drawing conventions rather than additional physical information, and the unquantified review envelope can look more scientific than its evidence warrants. Five scenes vary mainly around a graph; pipe candidates and provenance are less concrete than in other entries. Thin contours lose salience when reduced.

Context dimensional strips, structure algebra, explore analytical intersection, review's explicitly assumed K range and outcome folio form a traceable explanation. Choice persists and the 23.2 percent reduction is consistent with the model. The assumed interval is honestly distinguished from measured uncertainty, but the final checked Units traced claim overstates what the illustrative input strips establish. Ordered ink and numeric reveals support reading; repeated plot compositions are less physically expressive than C2/C3. Large numbers are useful while side annotations remain small.

calc.synthesis: Build a single hydraulic balance apparatus with a vertical head datum and a horizontal flow rail sharing geometry with one large pump/system plot. A restrained impeller and dimensional input tags establish the model; a throttle change raises the upstream head marker, narrows a continuous loss ribbon and moves the operating point left along the unchanged pump curve. Retain a ghost base point for comparison. During review, unfold a clearly assumed parameter interval beside open OEM and input questions, then carry the chosen relative result into an unselected candidate handoff. This combines physical behavior, energy accounting, one prominent readout and analytical traceability in a new composition, without dense contour decoration or a completed-check claim.

contributions.C1: Use the large relative-flow readout and a restrained calibrated arc. Animate the actual indicator change if used; reject unrelated rotor motion as evidence of operating behavior.
contributions.C2: Use the coupled throttle aperture, upstream head and flow-width response. Rebuild the apparatus around the shared plot datum rather than reproducing its two-vessel scene.
contributions.C3: Use one continuous energy-loss ribbon whose width and elevation have separately stated meanings. Keep any pipe/fitting allocation visibly illustrative and carry the selected geometry through review.
contributions.C4: Use the ghost baseline, invariant pump path and explicit lower-flow projection. Reject the decorative contour field and unlabeled uncertainty-like shading.
contributions.C5: Use unit-bearing input tags, an analytically derived readout and an explicitly assumed sensitivity interval. Keep units/provenance review open until actual supporting records exist.

scores.reason: Context territories, structure type/instance nesting, explore's changed contextual route, review frontier and outcome folded atlas provide strong visual variety. Named arrows and the survey diamond add meaning beyond color. However, geographic contours largely decorate arbitrary regions, and the CSS mostly reveals whole groups and draws a route rather than performing the described zoom/fold. Explore presents applies-to as a solid relation while pending applicability is mainly deferred to later phases. Long captions and multiple terrain labels become small.

Context type ribbons, structure complete statements, explore foreground selection, review's open gate and outcome context record form a legible sequence. Solid, dashed and double edges reduce color-only dependence. CSS stretches the active ribbon before its wording appears, giving the interaction a useful reading order, though it does not literally weave a preexisting thread. Type versus instance is clearest only at the end, and the remaining threads omit their full targets in explore. Small relation text limits the otherwise strong horizontal composition.

Context separates type/instance/evidence, structure explicitly names instance-of, explore marks applies-to as proposed, review leaves No verdict recorded, and outcome retains the named relationships. This is the strongest safeguard against treating support as applicability. Layer settling and the section reveal are mostly generic entrances; undashed route paths have no dash array, so changing dash offset does not itself trace those lines. The strata frequently resemble stacked bars, and the outcome carries too many small labels for easy mobile reading.

Context index leaves, structure's type/instance spread, explore's distinct statement leaf, review's separate provenance and pending seal, and outcome retained folio make the semantic categories approachable. Tab position, content and labels change with the entry choice. CSS rotates/translates the whole spread rather than articulating an actual hinge, so some described mechanics are inferred more strongly than implemented. Document geometry risks resembling TBE, but the instance-of relation and large paired labels keep the ontology purpose legible.

Context category baselines, structure class/member distinction, explore's subject-verb-object assembly, review's provenance/applicability split and outcome enlarged claim give motion a clear reading function. Staggered words and delayed status disclosure are directly supported by CSS. The selected sentence changes meaningfully rather than only color, and brackets/dots/italic relations provide redundant cues. Outcome returns to applies-to regardless of the explored perspective and drops the explicit evidence term, so continuity could improve. Large typography survives reduction best, although the pending label remains small.

ontology.synthesis: Create a semantic sentence workbench with a persistent type bracket and a distinct instance token, a single named relation ribbon, and a source margin separate from an empty review slot. Context first establishes category shapes; structure pulls the identified instance out from its type without changing identity. The selected entry then brings one complete subject-relation-object statement forward in reading order while the other facts remain faint but intact. Evidence attaches to the source margin; it never fills the review slot. Finish with the selected statement, its type/instance distinction, source and pending applicability together. Rework nesting, ribbon salience, separate strata, index-leaf selection and typographic sequencing into this new layout rather than copying the top-ranked entry.

contributions.O1: Use nested type territory and a precise instance marker, plus a visible review boundary. Reject most contour geography because it adds no engineering relation semantics.
contributions.O2: Use complete named statements and foreground selection with line-style distinctions. Reject decorative crossings whose omitted endpoints make the inactive facts difficult to inspect.
contributions.O3: Use the explicit proposed-application encoding and empty No verdict recorded review stratum. Reduce stacked bars and preserve the distinction between a review placeholder and an actual verdict.
contributions.O4: Use a selectable index-leaf cue to explain entry points and the explicit instance-of direction. Rework the leaf as a context selector; reject a full cabinet so ontology remains distinct from document review.
contributions.O5: Use ordered subject, relation and object reveals, category brackets and a solid instance dot. Keep the selected sentence and supporting evidence visible in the outcome instead of reverting to a fixed claim.

scores.reason: Context source leaves, structure clause alignment, explore's physical evidence vacancy, review's conditional clarification/draft and outcome jacket preserve the selected evidence state across the story. The empty leaf and changed next action communicate more than color. Sheet settling and lens arrival are attractive but mostly reveal completed compositions; the lens does not actually expose additional inspected content. Several 16–18px document labels and overlapping sheets will need small-width adjustment. Human judgment remains visibly separate from evidence linkage.

Context sources become structure lanes; explore isolates an evidence condition; review separates original from change/rationale; outcome keeps clarification or draft conditional. The scanning band has an authored three-position progression and a useful comparison purpose. However, explore's next action starts resolving at 1.7 seconds while the 4.6-second band is still reaching the selected first row, weakening the inferred inspection-to-action order. The matrix is precise but resembles a table more than a distinctive illustration, and reduced labels are small.

Context feeds, structure roller alignment and explore's physical output interlock make an exceptionally recognizable causal metaphor. CSS stages input, gate and output rather than merely pulsing shapes. However, review and outcome always show DRAFT and DRAFT ONLY, even after Evidence missing, directly contradicting the held-output branch. Both conditions also animate the rollers. The bold composition and large blocked-output label read well; the downstream state error prevents the strongest concept from being the strongest complete narrative.

Context preserves the original beneath the reply, structure separates document roles, explore changes the evidence footprint, review changes clarification versus applicability question, and outcome files the corresponding artifact. Distinct source settling, overlay unveiling, proof tracing and filing animations give each phase a document-specific action. The pencil itself only enters rather than drawing in synchronization, so its causal role is modest. Sparse large serif copy and ample page areas aid readability; source and proposed content remain distinguishable without color alone.

Context clause, structure's two independent gates, explore's timed stop/pass sequence, review's preserved question and outcome's conditional archive form the strongest complete causal arc. CSS explicitly pauses passage while the evidence gate opens, and human approval stays pending. A source-geometry caveat remains: the linked baton pauses at center x=290, putting its leading edge at x=345 beyond the gate at x=327 before opening completes. Correct that overlap. Static endpoints remain clear; small secondary labels and the lens/human composition need responsive inspection.

tbe.synthesis: Build a new clause-alignment folio: retain requirement and vendor reply on two fixed source rails, with an evidence slot aligned to the same clause. A review bracket crosses those rails once, then the clause carrier reaches a physical support gate. Missing evidence stops the carrier before the gate and unfolds an attached clarification; linked evidence attaches a source slip, opens only that gate, and reveals a separate translucent draft layer. The human checkpoint stays visibly unresolved. Review exposes original, change and rationale together; outcome files either clarification or draft beside the unchanged source. Combine T2's alignment, T1's real vacancy, T3's interlock logic, T4's preserved layers and T5's timed checkpoints in new folio geometry. Never let later phases silently turn the missing branch into a draft.

contributions.T1: Use a physically empty evidence footprint that changes the next action and persists into review/outcome. Reject a decorative magnifier unless it reveals additional relevant clause content.
contributions.T2: Use the clause-aligned scan across requirement, reply and evidence. Reveal the next action only after the scan reaches that clause; reduce the matrix to one meaningful example for small screens.
contributions.T3: Use the physical unsupported-output interlock and explicit clarification branch. Reject unconditional draft scenes and roller motion that suggests successful processing while output is held.
contributions.T4: Use separate retained-original and working-draft layers, conditional proof wording and a filing action. Keep the large editorial spacing but avoid copying the entire palimpsest layout.
contributions.T5: Use independently timed evidence and human checkpoints with different endpoints. Recalculate carrier extents so the whole paper waits before the closed gate, and retain the selected branch through the final archive.
